items.headline: 'We Don't Have Decades': Why $500 Million Won't Break China's Grip on Batteries
items.snippet: Albemarle beat Q2 estimates with adjusted EPS of $3.75 on $1.74 billion in revenue, and management now expects to land at the high end of its $20 per kg LCE scenario. That would put full-year sales at $5.7 to $6 billion.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: US-headquartered Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: Albemarle shares were down 5.16% at $134.21 at the time of publication on Tuesday, according to Benzinga Pro data. JPMorgan expects third-quarter adjusted EBITDA of $668 million, down from $858 million in Q2.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target to $157 from $166.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares.
